summary: Completed comprehensive testing of User Toggle Status feature for DynSoft Pharma. All backend tests (9/9) passed. Frontend UI tests verified all required functionality.

backend: Get users list with is_active field

Status badges (Actif/Inactif) displayed on each user card
Toggle status buttons (Power icon) visible on each user card
Toggle status button disabled for current logged-in user

context_for_next_testing_agent: User toggle status feature fully tested and working. Backend endpoint PATCH /api/users/{user_id}/toggle-status toggles is_active field. Login endpoint correctly rejects users with is_active=false. Frontend Users.js page displays status badges and toggle buttons with proper disabled state for current user.
